name: search
description:
Search for relevant emails in the user's connected Outlook account (primary mailbox + optionally the Online Archive). Returns message summaries with short body previews (NOT full email content).

IMPORTANT: Results contain only a truncated body_preview snippet. To read the full email body, use outlook_get_message with the returned message_id. Never quote or reply based on the preview alone.

Two search modes:
1. query (KQL text search): from:sender@email.com, to:, subject:, has:attachment, received>=2024-01-01
2. filter (OData $filter): flag/flagStatus eq 'flagged', isRead eq false, importance eq 'high', hasAttachments eq true

Use query for text search OR filter for property-based filtering — they can't be combined in one request, so provide just one.
At least one of query or filter must be provided.

When constructing the query for time-sensitive or historical searches, use absolute date filters
(e.g., received>=2023-01-01 or received:2022-01-01..2025-12-31) rather than relative keywords.
For archive searches (include_archive=true, now default), the same query/filter is run against the
Online Archive and merged with the primary-mailbox results (deduplicated by message). The connector
adds no implicit date restriction, so include an explicit received/receivedDateTime clause when you
want to limit the period.

Set include_archive=true to also search the Exchange Online Archive (many orgs auto-move mail >~12 months old there via retention policies). The connector resolves and searches the Archive folder automatically; use outlook_list_folders only if you want to inspect the mailbox's folders directly.

When the user asks to read, show, or retrieve the full content/body of an email
(not just a preview or summary), set use_full_body=true. This returns the complete
HTML body instead of a truncated plain-text preview.

When presenting results:
- Present email content naturally and summarize key information
- Include sender, date, and subject when relevant to the user's question
- Do not fabricate email content - only use what is returned in the search results

query.description: KQL (Keyword Query Language) search query for Outlook messages. This value is automatically wrapped in $search="..." before being sent to the Microsoft Graph API, so do NOT include double quotes in this string (they will cause a 400 syntax error). Plain text without a property prefix searches from, subject, and body by default. Supports KQL property restrictions: from:sender, to:recipient, subject:keyword, body:keyword, hasAttachment:true, received:2022-01-01..2025-12-31, participants:name, cc:name, bcc:name, size:1..500000, importance:high, kind:email. Combine clauses with AND, OR, NOT (uppercase). Examples: 'from:alice@example.com AND hasAttachment:true', 'budget OR forecast', 'subject:quarterly report received:2022-01-01..2025-12-31'.

include_archive.description: Whether to also search the user's Exchange Online Archive folder in addition to the primary mailbox. Useful for finding mail older than ~12 months that retention policies have moved to archive. Defaults to true (the manifest sets this as the default for historical searches).

max_results.description: Maximum number of email messages to return (default 10, max 50)

use_full_body.description: When true, returns the full email body (HTML) instead of a truncated plain-text preview. Use when the user requests the complete content of emails.

filter.description: OData $filter expression for precise filtering. Can be used alone or with query. Examples: "flag/flagStatus eq 'flagged'" (flagged emails), "isRead eq false" (unread), "importance eq 'high'" (high importance), "hasAttachments eq true" (with attachments), "from/emailAddress/address eq 'user@example.com'". Multiple conditions: "isRead eq false and importance eq 'high'"
